title: 16P #3/#9: stop one-shot Push-branch full CI waste; count Ready CI by run attempt/job (Draft/skip separate)

why5.question: Why remove governance/task-one-approval-20261016 from Push triggers?
why5.answer: #401 already merged that one-shot branch; Push on it still ran full CI/CodeQL (#38971545678 / #38971545705), violating Issue #389 item #3 thrift (full gates only at Ready/final).

why5.question: Why change metrics collection to per-attempt jobs?
why5.answer: Issue #389 item #9 requires accurate efficiency measurement; counting workflow runs by name alone treated Draft fast-loop and skipped CodeQL as full CI and under-counted Ready re-runs (same run_id attempt 1/2/3 = three executed ci jobs).

why5.question: Why keep Draft fast-loop and Ready required checks?
why5.answer: Thrift must not weaken branch protection; Draft still runs fast-loop; Ready still requires ci/governance/attack/CodeQL. Metrics classify Draft skip separately instead of inventing PASS.

why5.question: Why INCOMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE instead of fake savings?
why5.answer: Without complete attempt/job evidence or a pre-reform baseline, publishing a savings percentage would be a false PASS. Fail closed and label legacy synthetic arrays as non-publishable.

why5.question: Why a separate PR from #402/#403?
why5.answer: #402 is exact five-file ADMINISTRATIVE_WITH_CARRY_FORWARD; #403 is one-file attack fixture. Mixing CI/metrics bytes into those digests would invalidate Human-approved exact candidates. This PR is Issue #389 GOVERNANCE_REFORM only.

alternatives: Keep one-shot Push branch forever (rejected; wastes full CI).
Count only distinct headSha once (rejected; hides Ready re-run cost).
Fold into #402/#403 (rejected; exact digests already frozen).
no_change: Without this fix, metrics remain distorted and Push-branch full CI continues to violate #3 thrift semantics.
rollback: Revert the six-file PR; Push again triggers on the one-shot branch; metrics revert to run-name counting.
negative_tests: Offline classifier must mark incomplete attempt/job sets INCOMPLETE
Legacy synthetic run arrays must not publish as full_ci_runs
Draft PR must still skip required ci job while running fast-loop

scope_exception.reason: Issue #389 still OPEN; items #3 and #9 require workflow+metrics correction on governance-only paths while Sprint 3 remains REVIEW. Procedural Sprint-3 closure (#402/#403) is deferred per Human 16P-first order.
scope_exception.risk: Workflow trigger changes affect CI cost and required-check semantics; metrics misclassification could claim fake efficiency. Exact digest + Human approval + Ready four gates remain mandatory.
scope_exception.follow_up: After Merge: observe scheduled/dispatch governance-metrics real run; verify Draft PR no longer triggers Push full CI on feature branches; then resume #403→#402 Sprint 3 admin closure.
scope_exception.expires_at_rule: Main governance policy max_ttl_seconds=1209600 (14 days); placeholder until Human sets approved_at_unix

notes: Issue #389 items #3 and #9 only. NOT Merge. NOT #402/#403. NOT Sprint 4. NOT Product PASS.

carry_forward.justification: Corrects CI thrift triggers and metrics classification only; creates no Product/Task Acceptance deferral and adds no permanent GAP beyond existing Main register truth.

known_limitations: CI cannot prove human_approval is from a person; Human provenance check remains mandatory.
Does not authorize Merge, Sprint 4, Product PASS, or folding into #402/#403.
Scheduled metrics observation still requires a real workflow run after Merge (or Human-authorized workflow_dispatch).
Other 14 of 16P items remain separate E2E obligations; this PR does not claim 16/16 VERIFIED.
